title: 上部 凡尘问道 第25章 遗忘者暗线接头上部 凡尘问道 第26章 解诅咒规则修复术
content_zh:
第1节追杀紧逼，接头人显踪
九州追杀令的金色符文还悬浮在天际，凌无妄抱着苏晚晴跟着神秘接头人钻进密林。身后的马蹄声越来越近，温衍带着天道卫和自发追杀的修仙者已追至林外，嘶吼声震得树叶簌簌作响。
“凌先生，快这边走！”接头人脚步飞快，黑色衣袍在林间划过残影。他戴着青铜面具，只露出一双深邃的眼睛，手中破法者令牌散发着微弱的原初灵气，与凌无妄的玉佩产生共鸣。
凌无妄心中仍有警惕，规则之眼悄然运转【检测到接头人灵力波动原初灵气纯度70%，无闭源符文痕迹。身份可疑度30%。警告后方300米处出现金丹期灵力反应，追杀者已锁定方位】
“你是谁？为什么要帮我们？”凌无妄一边疾跑，一边沉声发问。苏晚晴靠在他怀里，气息逐渐平稳，但九州追杀令的标记让她浑身刺痛。
接头人转头，面具下的声音带着沙哑“我叫顾淮（取自《诗经·邶风·绿衣》“绿兮衣兮，绿衣黄裳”，顾为古韵姓氏，淮取淮河之水意象，适配接头人沉稳隐秘的特质），是遗忘者联盟的外勤执事。”
他抬手抛出一枚黑色符箓，符箓落地瞬间化作一道隐形屏障，暂时阻挡了追杀者的感知“联盟由三万年未被墨规子肃清的清醒者组成，我们一直在寻找破法者，也就是你。”
“清醒者？”苏晚晴虚弱地开口，“你们知道飞升骗局的真相？”
“不仅知道，我们还在反抗。”顾淮话音刚落，林外传来剧烈的灵力爆炸，隐形屏障剧烈震动，显然是金丹期修士出手了。
【检测到屏障破碎倒计时10息。追杀者数量23人，含1名金丹修士（温衍）、12名天道卫、10名修仙者】
顾淮脸色一变“温衍的闭源功法能撕裂隐匿屏障，我们必须尽快抵达安全屋！”他转身朝着密林深处狂奔，手中令牌亮起红光，沿途的树木突然自动偏移，让出一条隐秘小径。
凌无妄抱着苏晚晴紧随其后，规则之眼发现小径两旁的草木都刻有细微的原初符文——这是联盟布下的引路禁制，能屏蔽闭源灵气的追踪。但他同时注意到，顾淮的步法中藏着一丝闭源规则的痕迹，像是刻意模仿墨规子像是刻意模仿墨规子麾下修士的行动逻辑。
“你身上有闭源规则的气息。”凌无妄突然停下脚步，指尖凝聚原初灵气，“说清楚，你到底是谁！”
顾淮也停了下来，面具下的眼神闪过一丝复杂“这是为了潜入天道卫获取情报的伪装，若不信，你可以用规则之眼检测我的令牌核心。”
此时，屏障破碎的巨响传来，温衍的怒吼声穿透密林“凌无妄，我看你能躲到哪里！”
第2节令牌验身，联盟秘辛现
凌无妄没有犹豫，规则之眼聚焦顾淮手中的破法者令牌。令牌核心浮现出复杂的原初符文，与他玉佩上的纹路隐隐契合，且符文流动逻辑完全遵循开源规则，没有任何闭源篡改的痕迹。
【检测到令牌核心符文原初开源符文，与宿主玉佩共鸣度85%。接头人身份可信度提升至80%。警告金丹修士已进入密林，距离100米】
“抱歉，事关重大，不得不防。”凌无妄收起灵气，加快脚步跟上顾淮。
顾淮没有计较，一边带路一边解释“三万年前景天宗覆灭后，墨规子篡改天道，建立闭源规则体系，将所有质疑者定为异端。遗忘者联盟就是由当年的幸存者、被废灵根的修士和觉醒原初血脉的人组成。”

他顿了顿，补充道“老乞丐是我们的盟主，道号‘开源子’，当年曾是你麾下的规则守护者。三万年了，他一直在等你归来，推翻墨规子的统治。”
“等我？”凌无妄心中一动，“他知道我的身份？”
“不仅知道，他还保管着你当年留下的半块神格碎片。”顾淮的声音压低，“但十年前，墨规子发现了联盟的踪迹，对盟主下了‘蚀灵诅咒’，让他的原初灵气不断流失，如今只剩三个月的寿命。”
苏晚晴闻言，脸色更加苍白“那诅咒……能解吗？”
“只有你能解。”顾淮转头看向凌无妄，“盟主说，你的规则之眼不仅能破法，还能修复被篡改的规则，而他身上的诅咒，本质上是被闭源规则污染的原初符文。”
说话间，三人抵达密林深处的一处山洞。洞口被藤蔓覆盖，藤蔓上的原初符文闪烁，形成隐形屏障。顾淮抬手按在屏障上，令牌红光闪过，屏障缓缓打开。
山洞内别有洞天，石壁上刻满开源符文，几名身着统一黑色衣袍的修士正在忙碌。看到凌无妄和苏晚晴，他们纷纷停下手中的动作，眼神中充满敬畏。
“这是联盟的临时安全屋。”顾淮介绍道，“我们会在这里为苏姑娘疗伤，同时为你准备前往联盟总部的路线。”
一名白发修士上前，递来一瓶丹药“凌先生，这是《开源丹》，能暂时压制九州追杀令的标记，缓解苏姑娘的伤势。”
凌无妄接过丹药，规则之眼检测确认无异常后，喂苏晚晴服下。丹药入口即化，一股温和的原初灵气扩散开来，苏晚晴脸上的血色逐渐恢复。
但就在这时，山洞顶部的开源符文突然闪烁红光，发出警报声。顾淮脸色骤变“不好！有人追踪到了这里，是天道卫的‘追灵鸟’！”
content_en:
In the first quarter, the press is pursued, and the contact person is missing.
The golden runes of the Jiuzhou fatwa were still suspended in the sky. Ling Wuwang hugged Su Wanqing and followed the mysterious contact into the dense forest. The sound of horse hooves behind him was getting closer and closer. Wen Yan, along with the Tiandao guards and the immortal cultivators who were chasing him, had already chased him outside the forest. The roar made the leaves rustle.
"Mr. Ling, come this way!" The contact person's footsteps were fast, and his black robe left an afterimage in the forest. He wore a bronze mask, revealing only a pair of deep eyes. The spellbreaker token in his hand exuded a weak original aura, which resonated with Ling Wuwang's jade pendant.
Ling Wuwang was still vigilant in his heart, and the Eye of Rules was quietly operating [It was detected that the connector's spiritual power fluctuated. The purity of the original spiritual energy was 70%, and there were no traces of closed source runes. The identity suspiciousness level is 30%. Warning: Golden elixir stage spiritual power reaction appears 300 meters behind, and the pursuer has locked the location]
"Who are you? Why do you want to help us?" Ling Wuwang asked in a deep voice while running quickly. Su Wanqing leaned into his arms, her breathing gradually calming down, but the mark of the Jiuzhou fatwa made her whole body tingle.
The connector turned his head, and the voice under the mask was hoarse, "My name is Gu Huai (taken from "The Book of Songs Bei Feng Green Clothes" "Green clothes, green clothes and yellow clothes", Gu is an ancient surname, Huai takes the image of the water of the Huaihe River, which suits the calm and secretive characteristics of the connector), and I am a field deacon of the Forgotten Alliance."
He raised his hand and threw a black talisman. The talisman instantly turned into an invisible barrier when it hit the ground, temporarily blocking the perception of the pursuer. "The alliance is composed of conscious people who have not been eliminated by Mo Guizi for 30,000 years. We have been looking for the lawbreaker, which is you."
"Sober people?" Su Wanqing said weakly, "Do you know the truth about the ascension scam?"
"Not only do we know, we are still resisting." As soon as Gu Huai finished speaking, there was a violent spiritual explosion outside the forest, and the invisible barrier shook violently. It was obviously the Golden Core monk who took action.
[Countdown of 10 breaths after the barrier is detected. The number of pursuers is 23, including 1 Jindan monk (Wen Yan), 12 Tiandao guards, and 10 immortal cultivators]
Gu Huai's expression changed. "Wen Yan's closed-source technique can tear apart the concealment barrier. We must reach the safe house as soon as possible!" He turned and ran towards the depths of the dense forest. The token in his hand lit up red, and the trees along the way suddenly shifted automatically, leaving a hidden path.
Ling Wuwang hugged Su Wanqing and followed closely. The Eye of Rules discovered that the vegetation on both sides of the path was engraved with subtle primitive runes - this was a guidance restriction set by the alliance, which could block the tracking of closed-source spiritual energy. But he also noticed that there was a trace of closed-source rules hidden in Gu Huai's footwork, as if he was deliberately imitating Mo Guizi or deliberately imitating the action logic of the monks under Mo Guizi's command.
"You have the aura of closed-source rules." Ling Wuwang suddenly stopped and condensed the original spiritual energy on his fingertips, "Tell me clearly, who are you!"
Gu Huai also stopped, and a hint of complexity flashed through his eyes under the mask, "This is a disguise to sneak into the Tiandao Guard to obtain intelligence. If you don't believe it, you can use the Eye of Rules to detect the core of my token."
At this time, there was a loud noise of the barrier breaking, and Wen Yan's roar penetrated the dense forest, "Ling Wuwang, let's see where you can hide!"
Section 2 Token Testing, Alliance Secrets Revealed
Ling Wuwang did not hesitate, his eyes of rules focused on the Spellbreaker Token in Gu Huai's hand. Complex original runes appeared in the core of the token, which vaguely matched the lines on his jade pendant, and the rune flow logic completely followed the open source rules, without any trace of closed source tampering.
[The original open source rune of the token core rune was detected, and the resonance level with the host jade pendant is 85%. The credibility of the contact's identity is increased to 80%. Warning Jindan monk has entered the dense forest, 100 meters away]
"Sorry, the matter is so important that we have to guard against it." Ling Wuwu put away his spiritual energy and quickened his pace to follow Gu Huai.
Gu Huai didn't care, and explained while leading the way, "After the collapse of the Tianzong in thirty thousand years, Mo Guizi tampered with the way of heaven and established a closed source."A system of rules that condemns all doubters as heretics. The Alliance of the Forgotten is composed of the survivors of the year, the monks whose spiritual roots were destroyed, and those who awakened the original bloodline. "
He paused and added, "The old beggar is our alliance leader, his Taoist name is 'Yuanyuanzi', and he was the guardian of the rules under you back then. For thirty thousand years, he has been waiting for you to return and overthrow Mo Guizi's rule. "
"wait for me? Ling Wuwang's heart moved, "Does he know my identity?" "
“Not only does he know, he also keeps half of the fragment of your godhead that you left behind back then. Gu Huai lowered his voice, "But ten years ago, Mo Guizi discovered the alliance's traces and placed a 'soul-eating curse' on the alliance leader, which caused his original aura to continue to drain. Now he only has three months left to live." "
When Su Wanqing heard this, her face became even paler, "The curse...can it be undone?" "
"Only you can figure it out. Gu Huai turned to look at Ling Wuwang, "The alliance leader said that your Eye of Rules can not only break laws, but also repair tampered rules, and the curse on him is essentially the original rune contaminated by the closed source rules." "
While talking, the three of them arrived at a cave deep in the dense forest. The entrance to the cave was covered with vines, and the original runes on the vines flickered, forming an invisible barrier. Gu Huai raised his hand and pressed it on the barrier. The red light of the token flashed and the barrier slowly opened.
There is a cave inside the cave. The stone walls are carved with open source runes, and several monks in uniform black robes are busy. Seeing Ling Wuwang and Su Wanqing, they all stopped what they were doing, their eyes filled with awe.
“This is a temporary safe house for the league. "Gu Huai introduced, "We will heal Miss Su here and prepare a route for you to the alliance headquarters. "
A white-haired monk stepped forward and handed over a bottle of pill, "Mr. Ling, this is the "Open Source Pill". It can temporarily suppress the mark of the Kyushu Fatal Order and relieve Miss Su's injuries. "
Ling Wuwang took the elixir, and after checking with the Eye of Rules that there was no abnormality, he fed Su Wanqing to take it. The elixir melted in the mouth, a gentle original spiritual energy spread, and the color on Su Wanqing's face gradually returned.
But at this moment, the open source rune on the top of the cave suddenly flashed red and sounded an alarm. Gu Huai's expression suddenly changed, "No! Someone has tracked it here, it’s Tiandao Guard’s ‘Spirit Chasing Bird’! "
